subject: I wasn't going to send this confession
preview_text: The truth about why I almost quit building this app last month. This changes everything about healing.
body_paragraphs: I don't usually write emails like this, but I need to tell you something. Last month, I almost shut down Fresh Start. Not because it wasn't working, but because I was watching people's pain up close every single day and it started breaking me too.

I'd read the journal entries in our anonymous sharing feature. I'd see the 3AM emergency mode activations spike at 2:47 AM like clockwork. I started carrying your heartbreak with me, and one Tuesday I just sat at my desk and thought: I can't do this anymore. The weight was too heavy. Then I checked the progress charts.

That's when I saw it—the exact moment where the mood tracking lines start trending upward. It happens for almost everyone between day 18 and day 35. The obsessive thoughts decrease by 62% on average. The emergency mode usage drops off a cliff. You're right in that window now.

Open the app today and check your progress chart. Just look at it. See how far you've actually come, even on the days it didn't feel like it. I'm not shutting anything down. We're just getting started. P.S. The users who check their progress chart this week are 3x more likely to hit 30 days no-contact.
